lines.t: Coils off, pens open, Warden gone. I've filed it all under 'Miscellaneous'. It's a very large folder now.
For what it's worth — the strays sang on their way out. I've never heard this building make a happy noise before.
You're signed in. That makes you a visitor, not an intruder. The difference is mostly ink.
Visitors must sign in. …You haven't signed in.
Name, purpose of visit, and whether you are, or have ever been, a loud stone. Take your time.

options.label: Sign in with my own name

lines.t: Both wings, clear! Well. You cleared both wings. I cleared a biscuit tin. We each contributed.
The theatrical one's in the office up north. I can hear her doing vocal warm-ups. It's upsetting.
Update on the right wing: there's an engineer. She asked me to sign in. I panicked and ran. Strategy!
Left wing's a workshop, right wing's full of coils. The lost-noisy kin sound is coming from further north. Past the office.
You deal with the engineers, I'll… guard the door. From danger. And doormats.
*The hero, halfway through the second act.* Don't rush the ending, darling. One more of my engineers to go.
*Places, everyone.* Oh — it's the critic from the fen. How lovely. How *early*.
No, no. The Warden doesn't go on before the chorus. My engineers are in the wings — west and east. Do meet them.
Come back when the audience is warmed up. I'll be rehearsing my bow.
Empty pens. I scrubbed them anyway. Force of habit.
Fed them twice daily, every one. I knew all their names. I'd made the names up, but still.
Warden's orders were 'hold until the network is stable'. The Warden's gone and the coils are cold. So.
The gate's unlatched. Your friend's already in there, being loud at them. They seem to like it.
Pen duty. Very clean pens, for the record. Straw changed daily. Water from the good spring.
Stray, young, triad line — found route_1, day 1. Fed twice daily. Nervous.
We only pen strays. When the network's stable, they go home. That was always the plan.
Gate's locked on the Warden's say-so. And the Warden says a great deal.
Take the little one home to Oriel. I'll be out on the west trail, being mysterious. It's a whole look.
And {player}? Thanks. For letting me be here for this bit.
{player}. Look at them all. Fed, brushed, tagged. It's the tidiest sad thing I've ever seen.
Stray, young, triad line — found route_1, day 1. Fed twice daily. Nervous.
Route_1. Day one. That's — that's ours. The one that bolted from the fosterage.
A small {leftover} peeks out from behind the water trough, ears flat. Cass crouches and holds out a hand.
It hesitates… then slips right past Cass, and presses its nose against your {starter}.
Hey. Hey, it's okay. We've been looking for you.
It won't come to me. It's going straight to your {starter}. …Figures. Family recognizes family.
Somewhere below, a coil clunks and falls silent. One by one, the strays lift their heads — and start to hum.
Hear that? The coils are off. They can hear their stones again. They'll find their own way home now.
The {leftover} climbs into your satchel, turns around twice, and refuses to discuss the matter further.
You found it? Bring the little one home when you can. I'll put the kettle on — and, {player}, thank you.
Visitors must sign in. …You haven't signed in.
Right. Fine. The pens are through there. They're very clean pens, for the record.
We only pen strays. When the network's stable, they go home. That was always the plan.
Is this about the coil? Everyone's always upset about the coil.
Your friend in the scarf already came through. I asked them to sign in and they ran. Very fast. Very loudly.
Well, that wasn't in the risk assessment.
We don't *take* kin. We collect strays. There's a difference. There's a form for it.
*Act three. The hero storms the theatre.* You're dripping on my floors.
Do you know what this place is, darling? A sanctuary. Every stray the silence shook loose — safe, fed, *quiet*.
And you want to throw open the doors and let them run toward the next loud stone. How very… improvised.
*Curtain.* …The Magister is already on Hoarcrown, darling. You're late to your own finale.
Keep the Etude. Umbral Pulse. It never did go with my coat.
The coils are yours to switch off. The pens too. *Exit, pursued by absolutely no one.*
Visitors must sign in. …You haven't signed in.
Right. Fine. The pens are through there. They're very clean pens, for the record.
We only pen strays. When the network's stable, they go home. That was always the plan.
*Act three. The hero storms the theatre.* You're dripping on my floors.
*Curtain.* …The Magister is already on Hoarcrown, darling. You're late to your own finale.
*Encore declined.* Out you go.
